translations.开启查找设备，可远程定位、锁定、备份和清除数据，提升设备遗失后找回的概率。: Enable Find Device to locate, lock, back up, and erase your device remotely, improving your chances of recovering it if lost.
translations.设置锁屏时关机需要解锁: Require unlocking to power off a locked device
translations.防止设备遗失后被他人关机，可设置锁屏时关机需要解锁。: Require unlocking before powering off a locked device to prevent someone else from turning it off after it is lost.
translations.SIM卡锁可防止他人使用您的手机SIM卡。密码输入错误达到三次后，手机SIM卡将: SIM lock prevents others from using your SIM card. The SIM card will be permanently locked after three incorrect password attempts. Enable with care.
translations.手机遗失后请立即登录查找设备并锁定设备。: If your phone is lost, sign in to Find Device immediately and lock it.
translations.致电运营商挂失手机SIM卡可防止他人通过短信验证码盗取您的账号信息。: Call your carrier to report your SIM card lost and prevent others from accessing your accounts through SMS verification codes.
translations.从列表移除此设备，移除后，此设备的“查找设备”功能将被关闭。: Remove this device from the list. Find Device will be disabled on this device.
translations.清除设备中的所有数据并恢复出厂设置，清除成功后，您将无法进行定位、响铃、设为丢失: Erase all data and restore factory settings. After erasure, you cannot locate, ring, or mark the device as lost. Your vivo account password or screen-lock password is required to activate and use it again.
Erase all data and restore factory settings. After erasure, you cannot locate, ring, or mark the device as lost.
translations.锁定设备屏幕，并显示联系方式及留言，需要正确输入账号密码才能解锁设备。: Lock the screen and display contact details and a message. The account password is required to unlock the device.
translations.联系方式及留言仅支持部分机型。: Contact details and messages are supported on selected models only.
translations.锁定设备屏幕后需要正确输入vivo账号密码才能解除锁定，请谨慎使用。: Your vivo account password is required to unlock the screen after locking it. Use with care.
translations.您好，此手机已丢失，请拨打电话联系我。: Hello, this phone is lost. Please call me.
translations.您有 1 条由“查找”网络更新的位置: You have 1 location update from the Find network
translations.暂无设备开启查找，请在设备本地操作，开启前需登录 vivo 账号: No devices have Find Device enabled. Sign in to your vivo account and enable it on your device.
translations.在您的设备上进入“云服务”（默认位于桌面）。: Open Cloud Services on your device (on the Home screen by default).
translations.在“云服务”首页点击“查找”菜单以进入。: Tap Find on the Cloud Services home page.
translations.在“查找”页面开启“查找设备”开关。: Enable Find Device on the Find page.
translations.您可对设备进行定位、锁定、清除等查找操作。: You can locate, lock, erase, and perform other Find Device actions.
translations.位置由“查找”网络更新: Location updated by the Find network
translations.锁定屏幕后，连续 2 次输入错误密码，前置摄像头将自动拍照，仅保存最近 8 张照: After the screen is locked, entering an incorrect password twice in a row triggers the front camera. Only the latest 8 photos are kept.
translations.进入丢失模式后，连续 2 次输入错误密码，前置摄像头将自动拍照，仅保存最近 8: In Lost mode, entering an incorrect password twice in a row triggers the front camera. Only the latest 8 photos are kept.
translations.为确保位置数据的隐私安全，由“查找”网络更新的位置已在客户端加密保护。可在登录您: To protect your privacy, locations updated by the Find network are encrypted on the device. View this location on a phone signed in to your vivo account with the Find network enabled.
To protect your privacy, locations updated by the Find network are encrypted on the device. View this location on a phone or tablet signed in to your vivo account with the Find network enabled.

notes: Read-only analysis of captured DOM and public shipped JavaScript. No device action was invoked.
Apply exact trimmed text matches only inside safeSelectors, with excludeSelectors taking priority. Preserve original leading/trailing whitespace.
Do not translate device names, account identifiers, addresses, map labels, location timestamps, route points, user messages, or input values.
Map/Hybrid labels are app-owned controls outside #map. Do not translate geographic labels or generic Baidu map DOM.
Hidden dialog strings are included as label translations only; never click their controls or invoke APIs.

Authentication .title-msg may combine fixed text and account identifiers. Exact matching can safely translate static messages; preserve combined account strings unchanged unless a narrowly scoped capture-and-preserve rule is explicitly added.
The SIM-lock warning translation follows the shipped text literally; this artifact does not provide SIM or device-security advice.
